Preserve the existing 3 reps with 10 seconds held per rep, but the actual source plateau is only 1.4 seconds per rep. The clip does not implement a 10-second hold; prescription/playback reconciliation requires editorial approval.

n-pelvis-circle.countingSemantics: Preserve the legacy rep_cycle interpretation: one complete circle in each direction is one 8-second rep cycle. The 0–0.6 and 7.4–8 second amplitude ramps overlap the angular phases.

switchPoint.semantics: First squat loads the right leg and straightens/raises toes of the left; after 4 seconds the left leg loads and right leg straightens. Highlight remains both. One lateral squat and return led by one loaded leg counts as one rep. The 8-second clip demonstrates one right-loaded then one left-loaded rep. Preserve FlareLab prescription: default reps=5 is per side (five full loops give five reps on each side), not five total alternating reps. Switch loaded leg at 4 seconds.
